#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

class Solver {
public:
    long long nCr[100][100];

    long long comb(long long base, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        base = (base * nCr[a][b]) % MOD;
        base = (base * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
        return base;
    }

    void solve(int testNum, int n, int K, const vector<int>& coins) {
        int cnt50 = 0, cnt100 = 0;
        for (int coin : coins) {
            if (coin == 50) cnt50++;
            else cnt100++;
        }

        // Precompute binomial coefficients
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
                else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dist(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, INF)));
        vector<vector<vector<long long>>> ways(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, 0)));

        dist[0][0][0] = 0;
        ways[0][0][0] = 1;

        struct State {
            int x, y, side;
            long long dist;
            State(int x, int y, int side, long long dist) : x(x), y(y), side(side), dist(dist) {}
        };

        deque<State> queue;
        queue.emplace_back(0, 0, 0, 0);

        while (!queue.empty()) {
            State cur = queue.front();
            queue.pop_front();
            int x = cur.x;
            int y = cur.y;
            int side = cur.side;
            long long d = dist[x][y][side];

            if (side == 0) {
                int rem50 = cnt50 - x;
                int rem100 = cnt100 - y;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= rem50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= rem100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (weight > K) break;
                        int nx = x + take50;
                        int ny = y + take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nextSide] = d + 1;
                                queue.emplace_back(nx, ny, nextSide, d + 1);
                                ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int rem50 = x;
                int rem100 = y;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= rem50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= rem100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (weight > K) break;
                        int nx = x - take50;
                        int ny = y - take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nextSide] = d + 1;
                                queue.emplace_back(nx, ny, nextSide, d + 1);
                                ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[cnt50][cnt100][1] == INF) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << dist[cnt50][cnt100][1] << endl;
        }
        cout << ways[cnt50][cnt100][1] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<int> coins(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> coins[i];
    }

    Solver solver;
    solver.solve(1, n, K, coins);

    return 0;
}
